services.title: One place for every craving
services.sub: From morning coffee to gala dinner — handled by our pro team.

items.title: Specialty Coffee Bar
items.desc: Single-origin Gayo, Toraja & Kintamani brewed by certified baristas.
items.detail: Fresh-roast beans every week from Indonesia's 3 best origins. Manual brew (V60, Aeropress, Vietnam Drip) + espresso based. SCA-certified baristas.

items.title: Artisan Brunch & Resto
items.desc: 80+ Western–Indonesian dishes, halal, vegan & gluten-free options.
items.detail: Kitchen open 08.00–22.00. Favorites: Wagyu Sambal Matah, Truffle Aglio Olio, Nasi Campur Maven. All halal, kids menu available.

items.title: Corporate Catering
items.desc: Meeting packages, coffee breaks & lunch boxes for 20–500 pax.
items.detail: Trusted by 200+ companies. On-time delivery, buffet setup, tableware, prasmanan / lunch box options. Tempo invoice & NPWP available.

items.title: Private Event Space
items.desc: Rooftop & VIP room for 150 pax, full sound + LED.
items.detail: Sunset rooftop + indoor VIP room. Birthdays, proposals, office gatherings, acoustic nights. Sound, mic, LED, and event LO included.

items.title: Franchise / Partnership
items.desc: Starting from IDR 350M, 12–18 mo payback, full training & SOP.
items.detail: 3 types: Express (takeaway), Regular (80m2 cafe), Flagship (200m2 resto). Includes design, equipment, 14-day training, SOP, priority bean supply.

items.title: Beans & Subscription
items.desc: Weekly fresh roast beans + machine rental for offices/cafes.
items.detail: Weekly/monthly bean subscription for home, office, or your cafe. Free calibration + espresso machine rental from 500K/month.

items.title: Butterscotch Latte
items.desc: Best seller 3 years in a row.
items.detail: Our signature: double-shot espresso + homemade butterscotch + creamy milk. Less sugar / oat milk available. 250ml & 500ml takeaway.

items.title: Wagyu Sambal Matah
items.detail: Tender wagyu slices + Balinese sambal matah + warm liwet rice. Spice level 1–5 on request.

items.title: Rooftop Sunset Session
items.detail: Every Friday 17.00–21.00: live acoustic + buy 1 get 1 coffee. Best sunset view in Kemang. Book H-1.

items.title: Tech Company Gathering
items.detail: Case study: 300-pax unicorn gathering. 2-hr setup, 4 live cooking stalls, unlimited coffee bar. NPS 9.2/10.

items.title: Manual Brew Bar
items.detail: Brew with our barista: pick beans, pick method, taste fruity/nutty/choco notes. For enthusiasts.

items.title: Family Weekend Brunch
items.detail: Sat–Sun 09.00–14.00: 4 mains + 4 drinks + 1 sharing dessert. Kids <5 free nuggets & milk.
